tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Identify the HanoLab account connected to these tools.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Read the connected account’s plan and available credits. Does not purchase credits.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List the connected user’s own saved voices and whether they are ready. If none are ready, open voicelab to create one.

tools.name: create_upload_link
tools.description: Create a private one-hour browser upload link. Ask the user to open it, choose an audio file or MP4 and return here. Requires the same HanoLab account; no credits are spent. This tool cannot read local paths or ChatGPT attachments directly.

tools.name: list_audio
tools.description: List recent audio uploaded through this connection. Use the exact audio_id, never a local path or an arbitrary URL.

tools.name: prepare_voice_conversion
tools.description: Prepare a fixed quote for uploaded audio and a ready owned voice. No credits are spent. Explain estimated_credits, obtain the user’s budget and explicit confirmation, then use convert_voice with this exact quote_id.

tools.name: convert_voice
tools.description: Spend HanoLab credits to submit the prepared conversion ONLY after the user confirms its cost and budget. Reuse the exact quote_id after interruption: repeated calls return the original task without another debit. A failed task needs a separate user decision before a new quote.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Check an owned task and return completed audio links. Refreshes worker status and may persist completion or a failure refund. Poll about every 10 seconds; do not submit a new paid task while waiting.

tools.name: list_conversions
tools.description: Find recent conversions submitted with this connection. Use get_task to refresh a task. This does not start new tasks.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_audio · Private data: create_upload_link · Public sink: create_upload_link, convert_voice, get_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_audio · Private data: create_upload_link · Public sink: create_upload_link, convert_voice, get_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
